limits: total_financial_debt excludes finance lease obligations (2,511) per the definition. Including them gives 158,150, the 'Total debt' shown in Note 7 and Item 7.
Net income is the group's share (17,174), not consolidated net income (17,608).
Shareholders' equity (104,460) is computed as total equity minus non-controlling interests, since the balance sheet does not show a single attributable-equity subtotal.

Frontier (closed Jan 20, 2026) and Starry (closed Jan 30, 2026) are after year-end and not in the 2025 figures. Their effects on debt and cash are not reflected. The cash balance includes proceeds of notes issued to fund Frontier, which depresses net debt relative to post-closing levels.

Page numbers are those printed in the report (Item 8 financial statements start at p. 49). The exhibits attached to the document (executive agreements, debt descriptions) were not used for the figures.
